chapters.title: First sprouts
chapters.blurb: Print, variables, math, decisions and loops.

lessons.title: Say hello
goals: Use print() to show a message
Make the console say exactly: Hello, garden!

lessons.title: Name your water
goals: Create a variable named water and set it to 4
lessons.starter_code: # Store a number in a variable, then print it

rules.hint: A variable is a name, an equals sign and a value: water = 4

lessons.title: Count the seeds
lessons.starter_code:
seeds = 6
pots = 3
# Print how many seeds you need in total

rules.hint: You can put a calculation inside print: print(a * b)

lessons.title: Sunny or not
goals: Write an if that checks sun > 5
Add an else for the other case
Print Grow! when the sun is bright
lessons.starter_code:
sun = 8
# If sun is above 5, print Grow! Otherwise print Wait

rules.hint: End the if line with a colon and indent the next line by 4 spaces.

lessons.title: Water every plant
goals: Use a for loop with range(3)
Print Water plant 1, Water plant 2 and Water plant 3
lessons.expected_output:
Water plant 1
Water plant 2
Water plant 3

rules.hint: range(3) counts 0, 1, 2. Print i + 1 to start at 1.
